component.name: Fresco
component.summary: Set videos and images as live wallpapers
将视频和图片设为动态壁纸

description.p: Fresco turns videos, GIFs, images, slideshows, and video playlists into your desktop wallpaper. Pick media in a simple app, click Set, then close the app — the wallpaper keeps playing and is restored on login.
Fresco 可将视频、GIF、图片、幻灯片和视频播放列表设为桌面壁纸。在应用中 选择媒体文件，点击「设置」后即可关闭应用——壁纸会继续播放，并在登录后 自动恢复。
Features:
功能：

ul.li: Looping video, animated GIF, static image, image slideshow, and video playlist wallpapers
循环视频、动态 GIF、静态图片、图片幻灯片和视频播放列表壁纸
Hardware-accelerated playback (VA-API / NVDEC) for low CPU usage without quality loss
硬件加速播放（VA-API / NVDEC），CPU 占用极低且不损失画质
A drag-to-crop and 90-degree rotate editor to frame exactly the region you want
支持拖拽裁剪和 90 度旋转的编辑器，精确取景
Per-wallpaper sound and volume, plus slideshow transitions (crossfade, fade, slide, Ken Burns)
逐张壁纸独立设置声音与音量，以及幻灯片转场效果（交叉淡入、淡入淡出、滑动、缓慢推移）
A wallpaper library with thumbnails, a recently-used row, and search
带缩略图、最近使用和搜索的壁纸库
Pause / resume, pause-on-battery, and auto-pause when a window goes fullscreen
暂停/继续、使用电池时暂停，以及窗口全屏时自动暂停
Multi-monitor support with per-display wallpapers and synced video playback
多显示器支持，可为每个显示器单独设置壁纸并同步播放视频
Add from a link: paste a Pinterest pin or a direct video/image URL
从链接添加：粘贴 Pinterest 图钉或视频/图片的直接链接
Day and night wallpaper schedules
日间与夜间壁纸定时切换
A curated in-app wallpaper catalog
应用内精选壁纸库
A command palette (Ctrl+K) for fast keyboard-driven control
命令面板（Ctrl+K），键盘快速操作

description.p: Fresco runs on X11 and on Wayland layer-shell compositors (COSMIC, Hyprland, Sway, KDE Plasma 6); GNOME on Wayland uses a static-frame fallback.
Fresco 可运行于 X11，以及支持 layer-shell 的 Wayland 合成器（COSMIC、 Hyprland、Sway、KDE Plasma 6）；GNOME on Wayland 使用静态帧回退方案。 在深度操作系统 Deepin 25 上，Fresco 运行于默认的 X11 会话。

Fixes reported by Deepin 25 users. On Deepin, clicking the desktop now keeps your icons visible for ten seconds before the wallpaper returns, instead of covering them again after two — Deepin draws its wallpaper and its icons into one window, so this is the layer Fresco can give back. The app window also no longer stops responding after the Language picker is opened, and the app menu no longer sits on top of the pages it opens.

Talk to the maintainer from inside Fresco. A private, two-way thread with no account and no email address, anonymous in both directions, so a problem can be worked through instead of ending at a rating nobody can follow up on. Bad feedback can now be replied to as well, if you allow it when you send it. Usage statistics are also clearer: everyone is asked again, because what the two answers mean has changed — both now count one anonymous install and its country, while the detail (your distro, desktop, city, and the exact time of use) is what accepting all adds. Full terms are in TERMS.md.

Widgets on your wallpaper. Synced song lyrics that follow whatever is playing, a clock with six themes including a translucent glass card with an analog face, an audio visualiser that draws the music, and a spinning album-art disc. All are off until you turn them on, none repaint unless what they show has changed, and the visualiser asks before it listens to your audio. Also a new app icon, and fixes for lyrics not following an automatic track change and for widgets appearing on only one display.

Select several wallpapers at once and remove them in a single step, with Select all honoring the current search. Power saving now defaults to Reduced, which measured about half the GPU power of Full quality for a barely noticeable softening; existing settings are kept. Also fixes the Light/Dark toggle and accent colors not applying until the app was restarted.

Power saving now reduces GPU scaling cost instead of skipping decoded frames — the earlier approach changed the visible frame rate but did not lower GPU load on hardware-decoded video. Also fixes the app icon not refreshing in the Deepin launcher after install, and makes removing or stopping the active wallpaper revert the desktop to its own background.

Replaces the 1.1.32 frame-rate cap with a Power saving control (Full quality / Reduced / Minimum). The old cap used a video filter that forced frames off the GPU and roughly doubled video decode load on hardware-decoded video; power saving now skips frames inside the decoder instead, leaving hardware decoding intact. Also fixes several light-mode readability problems, including an invisible Remove item in the wallpaper right-click menu.

Frame-rate cap for video wallpapers: a global default in Settings plus a per-wallpaper override in the editor (24/30/48/60 fps or original) to save battery and heat on low-end hardware. Also unifies the app icon artwork across launcher and taskbar.

Live wallpapers now really work on Deepin 25 (DDE): the wallpaper window is raised above DDE's own desktop window, fixing two bugs that made 1.1.3's Deepin support silently do nothing. Desktop icons are hidden while a live wallpaper is set on Deepin; other desktops are unaffected.

Deepin 25 (DDE) support: live wallpapers now show through the DDE desktop with icons intact, the app icon appears under the bloom icon theme (fixed-size PNG icons shipped in hicolor), and Deepin 25 joins the tested distro matrix.

Paste a Pinterest or direct media link to add a wallpaper, an optional browser new-tab wallpaper bridge with a companion extension, a Ctrl+K command palette, favorites, a media-first redesign with rich metadata cards, fullscreen auto-pause on COSMIC, and anonymous usage statistics behind a one-time consent dialog (nothing is sent unless you agree).

Live wallpapers now work on Ubuntu 24.04-based systems (COSMIC, Pop!_OS 24.04, Mint 22): Fresco ships one renderer per libmpv generation and picks the right one automatically. Self-finishing in-app updates with real download progress.
Multi-monitor video sync, schedule rotation fixes, smoother Wayland frame timing, and optional feedback reminders.
Rotation polish: card thumbnails follow the edited rotation; hover previews no longer play in the wrong orientation.
Reliable per-wallpaper sound, pixel-true 4K/8K quality, an in-app wallpaper catalog, per-display wallpapers, day/night schedules, add-from-URL, and X11 fullscreen auto-pause.
In-app updates with live progress, responsive layout, and a live status pill.
Rotate wallpapers, reliable per-wallpaper sound, native Wayland layer-shell probe.
Restore-on-login self-heal and cold-boot playback recovery.
Wayland layer-shell support, fullscreen auto-pause, update notifications.
Bug-fix release.

ul.li: Fixed a freeze/crash when changing the wallpaper.
Add and Add Folder now work; the file dialog shows videos and images by default.
The GNOME overview and lock screen now match the live wallpaper.

description.p: Initial release.
